info.title: Audiologist or ENT: who does what
info.subtitle: Two roles that care for your ears, and when to see each

rows.title: Audiologist
rows.desc: Tests hearing, fits and tunes hearing aids

rows.title: Otolaryngologist (ENT)
rows.desc: Physician treating ear disease and surgery

rows.title: Start with audiology
rows.desc: Gradual loss, trouble in noise, hearing aids

rows.title: Start with an ENT
rows.desc: Sudden loss, pain, drainage, or dizziness

rows.title: They work together
rows.desc: Each refers to the other when needed
